            else:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    ms=list(compiled.finditer(line))
                    if ms:
                        total_matches+=len(ms)
                        if opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']:
                            for m in ms:
                                matches_found.append((idx,line,m))
                        else:
                            matches_found.append((idx,line,ms[0]))
        if opts['count']:
            if total_matches>0:
                print(total_matches)
            if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
                elapsed=time.time()-start_time
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
                print(f"{1} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)
        if opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{1} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0)
        if opts['passthrough']:
            for line in lines:
                print(line.rstrip('\r\n'))
            if opts['stats']:
                elapsed=time.time()-start_time
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
                print(f"{1} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)

        numbers_enabled = opts['numbers'] if opts['numbers'] is not None else False
        before=opts['before']; after=opts['after']
        if opts['context']:
            before=opts['context']; after=opts['context']

        if before or after:
            match_lines=set([ln for ln,_,_ in matches_found])
            to_print=set()
            for ln in match_lines:
                for c in range(max(1, ln-before), min(len(lines)+1, ln+after+1)):
                    to_print.add(c)
            sorted_to_print=sorted(to_print)
            prev=None
            for ln in sorted_to_print:
                if prev is not None and ln-prev>1:
                    print("--")
                is_match = ln in match_lines
                sep = ':' if is_match else '-'
                content = lines[ln-1].rstrip('\r\n') if ln-1 < len(lines) else ''
                if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                    content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                if numbers_enabled or before or after or opts['column']:
                    if opts['column'] and is_match:
                        m=compiled.search(lines[ln-1]) if compiled else None
                        tmp=compiled.search(lines[ln-1]) if compiled else None
                        col=tmp.start()+1 if tmp else 1
                        print(f"{ln}{sep}{col}{sep}{content}")
                    else:
                        if numbers_enabled or before or after:
                            print(f"{ln}{sep}{content}")
                        else:
                            print(content)
                else:
                    if opts['only_matching'] and is_match:
                        for ln2, line2, mobj in matches_found:
                            if ln2==ln and mobj:
                                print(mobj.group(0))
                    else:
                        if is_match or opts['passthrough']:
                            print(content)
                prev=ln
        else:
            if opts['vimgrep']:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    if mobj:
                        tmp=compiled.search(line) if compiled else None
                        col=tmp.start()+1 if tmp else mobj.start()+1
                        print(f"{ln}:{col}:{line.rstrip()}")
                    else:
                        print(f"{ln}:{line.rstrip()}")
            elif opts['only_matching']:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    if mobj:
                        print(mobj.group(0))
                    else:
                        print(line.rstrip())
            elif opts['column']:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    tmp=compiled.search(line) if compiled else None
                    col=tmp.start()+1 if tmp else (mobj.start()+1 if mobj else 1)
                    content=line.rstrip('\r\n')
                    if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                        content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                    if numbers_enabled:
                        print(f"{ln}:{col}:{content}")
                    else:
                        print(f"{col}:{content}")
            else:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    content=line.rstrip('\r\n')
                    if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                        content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                    if numbers_enabled:
                        print(f"{ln}:{content}")
                    else:
                        print(content)
        if opts['stats']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{1} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)

    all_file_paths=[]
    for p in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            if not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {p}")
                eprint(f"ERR: Error opening directory {p}: No such file or directory")
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            all_file_paths.append((os.path.abspath(p), p))
        else:
            for abs_p, disp_p in walk_files(p, opts):
                all_file_paths.append((abs_p, disp_p))

    filtered=[]
    for abs_p, disp_p in all_file_paths:
        if opts['file_types']:
            matched=False
            for ft in opts['file_types']:
                for ext in FILE_TYPES.get(ft,[]):
                    if abs_p.endswith(ext):
                        matched=True; break
                if matched: break
            if not matched:
                if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                continue
        if opts['file_search_regex']:
            if not file_matches_regex(opts['file_search_regex'], abs_p) and not file_matches_regex(opts['file_search_regex'], disp_p):
                if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                continue
        filtered.append((abs_p, disp_p))
    all_file_paths=filtered
    all_file_paths.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])

    if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
        for abs_p, disp_p in all_file_paths:
            eprint(f"DEBUG: {abs_p} not ignored")
            eprint(f"DEBUG: {abs_p} added to work queue")

    files_searched=len(all_file_paths)
    bytes_total=0
    total_matches=0
    files_with_matches=0
    results=[]

    for abs_p, disp_p in all_file_paths:
        matches, count, b_search, is_bin = search_file(abs_p, disp_p, compiled, opts)
        bytes_total+=b_search
        if is_bin:
            total_matches+=1
            files_with_matches+=1
            results.append((disp_p, abs_p, [], 1, b_search, True))
            if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"DEBUG: Match found. File {abs_p}, offset 0 bytes.")
            continue
        if count>0:
            total_matches+=count
            files_with_matches+=1
            if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"DEBUG: Match found. File {abs_p}, offset 0 bytes.")
        else:
            if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"DEBUG: No match in {abs_p}")
        results.append((disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b_search, False))
        if opts['max_count'] and count>=opts['max_count']:
            try:
                with open(abs_p,'r',errors='ignore') as f:
                    txt=f.read()
                    if compiled:
                        all_m=len(list(compiled.finditer(txt)))
                        if all_m>opts['max_count']:
                            if not opts['silent']:
                                eprint(f"ERR: Too many matches in {disp_p}. Skipping the rest of this file.")
            except:
                pass

    single_file_mode=False
    if len(paths)==1 and os.path.isfile(paths[0]):
        if len(all_file_paths)==1:
            single_file_mode=True

    if opts['color'] is None:
        opts['color']=is_tty
    if opts['heading'] is None and opts['group'] is None:
        opts['heading']=is_tty
    if opts['break'] is None and opts['group'] is None:
        opts['break']=is_tty
    if opts['heading'] is None:
        opts['heading']=is_tty
    if opts['break'] is None:
        opts['break']=is_tty
    if opts['filename'] is None:
        if single_file_mode:
            opts['filename']=False
        else:
            opts['filename']=True
    if opts['numbers'] is None:
        opts['numbers']=True
    if opts['ackmate'] or opts['vimgrep']:
        opts['color']=False

    if opts['files_with_matches']:
        if not opts['stats_only']:
            for disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin in results:
                has_match = (count>0 or is_bin)
                if opts['print_all_files']:
                    if opts['null']:
                        sys.stdout.write(disp_p+'\0')
                    else:
                        print(disp_p)
                else:
                    if has_match:
                        if opts['null']:
                            sys.stdout.write(disp_p+'\0')
                        else:
                            print(disp_p)
        if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{files_with_matches} files contained matches")
            print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")

                        sys.stdout.write(disp_p+'\0')

            print(f"{files_with_matches} files contained matches")
            print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0)

    if opts['count']:
        if not opts['stats_only']:
            for disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin in results:
                has_match = (count>0 or is_bin)
                if opts['print_all_files']:
                    if single_file_mode and not opts['filename']:
                        print(f"{count}")
                    else:
                        print(f"{disp_p}:{count}")
                else:
                    if has_match:
                        if single_file_mode and not opts['filename']:
                            print(f"{count}")
                        else:
                            print(f"{disp_p}:{count}")
        if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            if opts['stats_only']:
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{files_with_matches} files contained matches")
                print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            else:
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{files_with_matches} files contained matches")
                print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)

    if opts['stats_only']:
        elapsed=time.time()-start_time
        print(f"{total_matches} matches")
        print(f"{files_with_matches} files contained matches")
        print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
        print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")
        print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0)

    def color_path(p):
        if opts['color']:
            return f"\033[{opts['color_path']}m{p}\033[0m\033[K"
        return p
    def color_lnum(n):
        if opts['color']:
            return f"\033[{opts['color_line_number']}m{n}\033[0m\033[K"
        return str(n)
    def color_match_text(txt):
        if opts['color']:
            return f"\033[{opts['color_match']}m{txt}\033[0m\033[K"
        return txt

    if opts['heading']:
        files_to_output=[]
        for disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin in results:
            has_match = (count>0 or is_bin)
            if has_match or opts['print_all_files']:
                files_to_output.append((disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin))
    else:
        files_to_output=[(disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin) for disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin in results if (count>0 or is_bin)]

    if opts['ackmate']:
        for idx_out, (disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin) in enumerate(files_to_output):
            if is_bin:
                print(f"Binary file {disp_p} matches.")

            line_to_matches={}
            line_to_content={}
            for ln, lc, mobj in matches:
                all_ms = list(compiled.finditer(lc)) if compiled else []
                if ln not in line_to_matches:
                    line_to_matches[ln]=[]
                    line_to_content[ln]=lc
                line_to_matches[ln].extend(all_ms)
            sorted_lns=sorted(line_to_matches.keys())
            if len(files_to_output)>1 or opts['print_all_files'] or not single_file_mode:
                if not single_file_mode or opts['heading'] or len(files_to_output)>1:
                    print(f":{disp_p}")
            for ln in sorted_lns:
                ms=line_to_matches[ln]
                if not ms:
                    continue
                pairs=",".join([f"{m.start()} {len(m.group(0))}" for m in ms])
                content = line_to_content[ln].rstrip('\r\n')

                    content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                if opts['only_matching'] and single_file_mode:
                    print(f"{pairs}:{content}")

        if opts['stats']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")

            print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")

        sys.exit(0)

    if opts['vimgrep']:
        for disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin in files_to_output:

            per_match=[]
            line_to_content={}

            for ln in sorted(line_to_content.keys()):
                lc=line_to_content[ln]
                all_ms=list(compiled.finditer(lc)) if compiled else []
                for m in all_ms:

            if not per_match:
                for ln, lc, _ in matches:
                    content=lc.rstrip('\r\n')
                    if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                        content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                    print(f"{disp_p}:{ln}:{content}")
                continue
            for ln, lc, mobj in per_match:
                col = mobj.start()+1
                content=lc.rstrip('\r\n')
                if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                    content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                print(f"{disp_p}:{ln}:{col}:{content}")
        if opts['stats']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{files_with_matches} files contained matches")
            print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_total} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0)

    if opts['heading']:
        for idx_out, (disp_p, abs_p, matches, count, b, is_bin) in enumerate(files_to_output):
            if is_bin:
                print(f"Binary file {disp_p} matches.")
                if opts['break'] and idx_out < len(files_to_output)-1:
                    print()
                continue
            if count==0 and opts['print_all_files']:
                print(f"{color_path(disp_p)}")
                if opts['break'] and idx_out < len(files_to_output)-1:

                continue
            print(f"{color_path(disp_p)}")
            try:
                with open(abs_p,'r',errors='ignore') as f:
                    all_lines=f.readlines()
            except:
                all_lines=[]
            before=opts['before']; after=opts['after']
            if opts['context']:
                before=opts['context']; after=opts['context']
            if before or after:
                match_lns=set([ln for ln,_,_ in matches])
                to_print=set()
                for ln in match_lns:

                    opts['debug']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='f':
                    opts['follow']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='F' or ch=='Q':
                    opts['literal']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='i':
                    opts['ignore_case']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='s':
                    opts['case_sensitive']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='S':
                    opts['smart_case']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='t':
                    opts['all_text']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='u':
                    opts['unrestricted']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='U':
                    opts['skip_vcs_ignores']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='v':
                    opts['invert_match']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='w':
                    opts['word_regexp']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='z':
                    opts['search_zip']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='n':
                    opts['norecurse']=True; opts['recurse']=False; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='r':
                    opts['recurse']=True; opts['norecurse']=False; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='V':
                    print("ag version 2.2.0\n\nFeatures:\n  +jit +lzma +zlib"); sys.exit(0)
                elif ch=='h':
                    print_help(); sys.exit(0)
                else:
                    if not opts['silent']:
                        eprint(f"{argv[0]}: invalid option -- '{ch}'")
                    print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
            i+=1; continue
        positional.append(arg); i+=1

    if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None and opts['file_search_regex'] is not None:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint("ERR: File search regex (-g or -G) already specified.")
        print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)

    pattern=None; paths=[]
    if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None:
        paths=positional if positional else ['.']
    else:
        if positional:
            pattern=positional[0]
            paths=positional[1:] if len(positional)>1 else []
        else:
            pattern=None; paths=[]
    if pattern is not None and not paths:
        paths=['.']
    return opts, pattern, paths

def load_ignore_patterns_from_file(filepath):
    pats=[]
    try:
        with open(filepath,'r',errors='ignore') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip()
                if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                    continue
                if line.startswith('!'):
                    continue
                pats.append(line)
    except:
        pass
    return pats

def should_ignore_file(filepath, opts, search_root):
    if not opts['hidden'] and not opts['unrestricted']:
        rel=os.path.relpath(filepath, search_root) if search_root and os.path.isdir(search_root) else os.path.basename(filepath)
        parts=rel.split(os.sep)
        for part in parts:
            if part.startswith('.') and part not in ('.','..'):
                return True
    basename=os.path.basename(filepath)
    rel=os.path.relpath(filepath, search_root) if search_root and os.path.isdir(search_root) else filepath
    parts=rel.split(os.sep)
    for pat in opts['ignore']:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(basename, pat) or basename==pat:
            return True
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(filepath, pat):
            return True
        for part in parts:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(part, pat) or part==pat:
                return True
    if opts['unrestricted'] or opts['all_types'] or opts['all_text']:
        return False
    try:
        search_root_abs=os.path.abspath(search_root) if search_root else None
    except:
        search_root_abs=None
    file_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(filepath))
    dirs_to_check=[]
    cur=file_dir; cnt=0
    while True:
        dirs_to_check.append(cur)
        if search_root_abs and os.path.abspath(cur)==search_root_abs:
            break
        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent==cur:
            break
        cur=parent
        cnt+=1
        if cnt>100:
            break
        if search_root_abs is None:
            break
    patterns=[]
    if opts['path_to_ignore']:
        patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(opts['path_to_ignore']))
    home=os.path.expanduser("~")
    agignore_home=os.path.join(home,".agignore")
    if os.path.isfile(agignore_home):
        patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(agignore_home))
    for d in dirs_to_check:
        ip=os.path.join(d,".ignore")
        if os.path.isfile(ip):
            patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(ip))
        if not opts['skip_vcs_ignores']:
            gp=os.path.join(d,".gitignore")
            if os.path.isfile(gp):
                patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(gp))
            hg=os.path.join(d,".hgignore")
            if os.path.isfile(hg):
                patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(hg))
            ge=os.path.join(d,".git","info","exclude")
            if os.path.isfile(ge):
                patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(ge))
    for pat in patterns:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(basename, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(filepath, pat):
            return True
        if basename==pat:
            return True
        for part in parts:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(part, pat) or part==pat:
                return True
    return False

def is_binary_file(path):
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            chunk=f.read(8192)
            if b'\0' in chunk:
                return True
    except:
        return False
    return False

def compile_pattern(pattern_str, opts):
    flags=0
    pat=pattern_str
    if opts['literal']:
        pat=re.escape(pat)
    if opts['word_regexp']:
        pat=r'\b'+pat+r'\b'
    if opts['case_sensitive']:
        flags=0
    elif opts['ignore_case']:
        flags=re.IGNORECASE
    else:
        if opts['smart_case']:
            if any(c.isupper() for c in pattern_str):
                flags=0
            else:
                flags=re.IGNORECASE
        else:
            flags=0
    if opts['multiline']:
        flags|=re.DOTALL
    try:
        compiled=re.compile(pat, flags)
    except re.error as e:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint(f"ERR: Bad regex! pcre_compile() failed at position {getattr(e,'pos',0)}: {e.msg}")
            eprint("If you meant to search for a literal string, run ag with -Q")
        sys.exit(2)
    return compiled

def file_matches_regex(regex_str, filepath):
    try:
        if re.search(regex_str, filepath):
            return True
        if re.search(regex_str, os.path.basename(filepath)):
            return True
    except re.error:
        pass
    return False

def walk_files(start_path_original, opts):
    start_abs=os.path.abspath(start_path_original)
    if os.path.isfile(start_abs):
        yield (start_abs, start_path_original)
        return
    max_depth=opts['depth']
    if max_depth==-1:
        max_depth=float('inf')
    stack=[(start_abs,0,start_path_original)]
    while stack:
        cur_abs, cur_depth, orig_prefix = stack.pop()
        if cur_depth>max_depth:
            continue
        try:
            entries=os.listdir(cur_abs)
        except Exception as e:
            if not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"ERR: Error opening directory {cur_abs}: {getattr(e,'strerror',str(e))}")
            continue
        for entry in entries:
            full_abs=os.path.join(cur_abs, entry)
            if orig_prefix == '.':
                display = os.path.relpath(full_abs, start_abs)
            else:
                rel = os.path.relpath(full_abs, cur_abs)
                display = os.path.join(orig_prefix, rel)
            if display.startswith("./"):
                display=display[2:]
            try:
                st=os.lstat(full_abs)
            except:
                if not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {full_abs}")
                continue
            is_link=stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)
            is_dir=stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)
            if is_link:
                if opts['follow']:
                    try:
                        rs=os.stat(full_abs)
                        is_dir=stat.S_ISDIR(rs.st_mode)
                    except:
                        if not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {full_abs}")
                        continue
                else:
                    continue
            if is_dir:
                if should_ignore_file(full_abs, opts, start_abs):
                    continue
                if cur_depth < max_depth:
                    if not opts['norecurse']:
                        stack.append((full_abs, cur_depth+1, display))
                continue
            else:
                if should_ignore_file(full_abs, opts, start_abs):
                    continue
                yield (full_abs, display)

def search_file(abs_path, display_path, compiled, opts):
    matches=[]
    total_count=0
    bytes_searched=0
    try:
        if is_binary_file(abs_path):
            if opts['all_text'] and not opts['search_binary']:
                return [],0,0,False
            if not (opts['all_types'] or opts['unrestricted'] or opts['search_binary']):
                return [],0,0,False
            try:
                with open(abs_path,'rb') as bf:
                    data=bf.read()
                    bytes_searched=len(data)
                    txt=data.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                    if compiled and compiled.search(txt):
                        return [],1,bytes_searched,True
                    else:
                        return [],0,bytes_searched,False
            except:
                return [],0,0,False

        lines=None
        if opts['search_zip']:
            if abs_path.endswith('.gz'):
                try:
                    with gzip.open(abs_path,'rt',errors='ignore') as f:
                        lines=f.readlines()
                except:
                    lines=None
            elif abs_path.endswith('.xz') or abs_path.endswith('.lzma'):
                try:
                    with lzma.open(abs_path,'rt',errors='ignore') as f:
                        lines=f.readlines()
                except:
                    lines=None
        if lines is None:
            with open(abs_path,'r',errors='ignore') as f:
                lines=f.readlines()
        bytes_searched=sum(len(l.encode('utf-8',errors='ignore')) for l in lines)

        use_multiline = opts['multiline'] and compiled and '\n' in compiled.pattern

        if use_multiline:
            full_text=''.join(lines)
            if opts['invert_match']:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    if not compiled.search(line):
                        matches.append((idx,line,None))
                        total_count+=1
                        if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                            break
            else:
                for m in compiled.finditer(full_text):
                    total_count+=1
                    start = full_text[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
                    end = full_text[:m.end()].count('\n')+1
                    for ln in range(start, end+1):
                        if ln-1 < len(lines):
                            lc=lines[ln-1]
                        else:
                            lc=''
                        matches.append((ln, lc, m))
                    if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                        break
                if not (opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']):
                    seen=set()
                    dedup=[]
                    for ln,lc,mobj in matches:
                        if ln not in seen:
                            seen.add(ln)
                            dedup.append((ln,lc,mobj))
                    matches=dedup
        else:
            for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                if opts['invert_match']:
                    if not compiled.search(line):
                        matches.append((idx,line,None))
                        total_count+=1
                        if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                            break
                else:
                    ms=list(compiled.finditer(line))
                    if ms:
                        total_count+=len(ms)
                        if opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']:
                            for m in ms:
                                matches.append((idx,line,m))
                        else:
                            matches.append((idx,line,ms[0]))
                        if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                            break
    except Exception as e:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint(f"ERR: Error opening file {abs_path}: {e}")
        return [],0,0,False
    return matches, total_count, bytes_searched, False

def main():
    start_time=time.time()
    opts, pattern, paths = parse_args(sys.argv)

    if pattern is None and opts['filename_pattern'] is None:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint("ERR: What do you want to search for?")
        sys.exit(1)

    if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
        home=os.path.expanduser("~")
        eprint(f"DEBUG: Found user's home dir: {home}")
        agignore_home=os.path.join(home,".agignore")
        if not os.path.isfile(agignore_home):
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping ignore file {agignore_home}: not readable")
        git_global=os.path.join(home,".config","git","ignore")
        if not os.path.isfile(git_global):
            eprint(f"DEBUG: global core.excludesfile: {git_global}")
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping ignore file {git_global}: not readable")
        q = pattern if pattern else opts['filename_pattern']
        if q:
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Query is {q}")
        eprint("DEBUG: PCRE Version: 8.39 2016-06-14")
        workers = opts['workers'] if opts['workers'] else 7
        eprint(f"DEBUG: Using {workers} workers")
        for i in range(workers):
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Thread {i} set to CPU {i}")
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Worker {i} started")
        for p in paths:
            eprint(f"DEBUG: searching path {p} for {q}")

    # -g mode
    if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None:
        try:
            flags=0
            if opts['ignore_case']:
                flags|=re.IGNORECASE
            elif opts['case_sensitive']:
                flags=0
            else:
                if opts['smart_case']:
                    if opts['filename_pattern'] and any(c.isupper() for c in opts['filename_pattern']):
                        flags=0
                    else:
                        flags|=re.IGNORECASE
            if opts['multiline']:
                flags|=re.DOTALL
            pat=opts['filename_pattern']
            if opts['literal']:
                pat=re.escape(pat)
            if opts['word_regexp']:
                pat=r'\b'+pat+r'\b'
            file_pat_re=re.compile(pat, flags)
        except re.error as e:
            if not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"ERR: Bad regex! pcre_compile() failed at position {getattr(e,'pos',0)}: {e.msg}")
                eprint("If you meant to search for a literal string, run ag with -Q")
            sys.exit(2)
        files_found=[]
        files_searched=0
        for p in paths:
            if not os.path.exists(p):
                if not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {p}")
                    eprint(f"ERR: Error opening directory {p}: No such file or directory")
                continue
            if os.path.isfile(p):
                files_searched+=1
                if opts['file_types']:
                    matched=False
                    for ft in opts['file_types']:
                        for ext in FILE_TYPES.get(ft,[]):
                            if p.endswith(ext):
                                matched=True; break
                        if matched: break
                    if not matched:
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {os.path.abspath(p)} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if opts['file_search_regex']:
                    if not file_matches_regex(opts['file_search_regex'], p):
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {os.path.abspath(p)} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if should_ignore_file(os.path.abspath(p), opts, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))):
                    continue
                if file_pat_re.search(p) or file_pat_re.search(os.path.basename(p)):
                    files_found.append(p)
                continue
            for abs_p, disp_p in walk_files(p, opts):
                files_searched+=1
                if opts['file_types']:
                    matched=False
                    for ft in opts['file_types']:
                        for ext in FILE_TYPES.get(ft,[]):
                            if abs_p.endswith(ext):
                                matched=True; break
                        if matched: break
                    if not matched:
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if opts['file_search_regex']:
                    if not file_matches_regex(opts['file_search_regex'], abs_p):
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if file_pat_re.search(disp_p) or file_pat_re.search(os.path.basename(disp_p)) or file_pat_re.search(abs_p):
                    files_found.append(disp_p)
        for f in files_found:
            if opts['null']:
                sys.stdout.write(f+'\0')
            else:
                print(f)
        if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{0} matches")
            print(f"{0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
            print(f"{0} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0)

    is_empty_query = (pattern == "")
    if not is_empty_query:
        compiled=compile_pattern(pattern, opts)
    else:
        compiled=None

    def stdout_is_tty():
        try:
            return os.isatty(1)
        except:
            return False
    def is_stdin_pipe():
        try:
            import stat as stmod
            mode=os.fstat(0).st_mode
            return stmod.S_ISFIFO(mode) or stmod.S_ISREG(mode)
        except:
            return False

    is_tty = stdout_is_tty()
    stdin_pipe = is_stdin_pipe()
    if opts['parallel']:
        stdin_pipe=False

    search_stdin=False
    if stdin_pipe and paths==['.']:
        search_stdin=True

    if search_stdin:
        stdin_data=sys.stdin.read()
        files_searched=1
        bytes_searched=len(stdin_data.encode('utf-8',errors='ignore'))
        total_matches=0
        matches_found=[]
        lines=stdin_data.splitlines(keepends=True)
        if not lines and stdin_data:
            lines=[stdin_data]
        if not is_empty_query:
            if opts['invert_match']:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    if not compiled.search(line):
                        matches_found.append((idx,line,None))
                        total_matches+=1
            else:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    ms=list(compiled.finditer(line))
                    if ms:
                        total_matches+=len(ms)
                        if opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']:
                            for m in ms:
                                matches_found.append((idx,line,m))
                        else:
                            matches_found.append((idx,line,ms[0]))
        if opts['count']:
            if total_matches>0:
                print(total_matches)
            if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
                elapsed=time.time()-start_time
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
                print(f"{1} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)
        if opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{1} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0)
        if opts['passthrough']:
            for line in lines:
                print(line.rstrip('\r\n'))
            if opts['stats']:
                elapsed=time.time()-start_time
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
                print(f"{1} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)

        numbers_enabled = opts['numbers'] if opts['numbers'] is not None else False
        before=opts['before']; after=opts['after']
        if opts['context']:
            before=opts['context']; after=opts['context']

        if before or after:
            match_lines=set([ln for ln,_,_ in matches_found])
            to_print=set()
            for ln in match_lines:
                for c in range(max(1, ln-before), min(len(lines)+1, ln+after+1)):
                    to_print.add(c)
            sorted_to_print=sorted(to_print)
            prev=None
            for ln in sorted_to_print:
                if prev is not None and ln-prev>1:
                    print("--")
                is_match = ln in match_lines
                sep = ':' if is_match else '-'
                content = lines[ln-1].rstrip('\r\n') if ln-1 < len(lines) else ''
                if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                    content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                if numbers_enabled or before or after or opts['column']:
                    if opts['column'] and is_match:
                        m=compiled.search(lines[ln-1]) if compiled else None
                        col=m.start()+1 if m else 1
                        print(f"{ln}{sep}{col}{sep}{content}")
                    else:
                        if numbers_enabled or before or after:
                            print(f"{ln}{sep}{content}")
                        else:
                            print(content)
                else:
                    if opts['only_matching'] and is_match:
                        for ln2, line2, mobj in matches_found:
                            if ln2==ln and mobj:
                                print(mobj.group(0))
                    else:
                        if is_match or opts['passthrough']:
                            print(content)
                prev=ln
        else:
            if opts['vimgrep']:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    if mobj:
                        col=mobj.start()+1
                        print(f"{ln}:{col}:{line.rstrip()}")
                    else:
                        print(f"{ln}:{line.rstrip()}")
            elif opts['only_matching']:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    if mobj:
                        print(mobj.group(0))
                    else:
                        print(line.rstrip())
            elif opts['column']:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    col=mobj.start()+1 if mobj else 1
                    content=line.rstrip('\r\n')
                    if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                        content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                    if numbers_enabled:
                        print(f"{ln}:{col}:{content}")
                    else:
                        print(f"{col}:{content}")
            else:
                for ln,line,mobj in matches_found:
                    content=line.rstrip('\r\n')
                    if opts['width'] and len(content)>opts['width']:
                        content=content[:opts['width']]+" [...]"
                    if numbers_enabled:
                        print(f"{ln}:{content}")
                    else:
                        print(content)
        if opts['stats']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{1} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)

    all_file_paths=[]
    for p in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            if not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {p}")
                eprint(f"ERR: Error opening directory {p}: No such file or directory")
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            all_file_paths.append((os.path.abspath(p), p))
        else:
            for abs_p, disp_p in walk_files(p, opts):
                all_file_paths.append((abs_p, disp_p))

    filtered=[]
    for abs_p, disp_p in all_file_paths:
        if opts['file_types']:
            matched=False
            for ft in opts['file_types']:
                for ext in FILE_TYPES.get(ft,[]):
                    if abs_p.endswith(ext):
                        matched=True; break
                if matched: break
            if not matched:
                if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                continue

                                opts['context']=c; opts['before']=c; opts['after']=c
                            else:
                                opts['context']=2; opts['before']=2; opts['after']=2
                        else:
                            opts['context']=2; opts['before']=2; opts['after']=2
                        j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='W':
                    rest=arg[j+1:]
                    if rest:
                        if rest.startswith('='):
                            rest=rest[1:]
                        try: opts['width']=int(rest)
                        except:
                            if not opts['silent']:
                                eprint("ERR: Invalid width")
                            sys.exit(2)
                        break
                    else:
                        if i+1 < len(args):
                            i+=1
                            try: opts['width']=int(args[i])
                            except:
                                if not opts['silent']:
                                    eprint("ERR: Invalid width")
                                sys.exit(2)
                        else:
                            if not opts['silent']:
                                eprint("ERR: Invalid width")
                            sys.exit(2)
                        j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='m':
                    rest=arg[j+1:]
                    if rest:
                        if rest.startswith('='):
                            rest=rest[1:]
                        try: opts['max_count']=int(rest)
                        except: opts['max_count']=10000
                        break
                    else:
                        if i+1 < len(args):
                            i+=1
                            try: opts['max_count']=int(args[i])
                            except: opts['max_count']=10000
                        j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='g':
                    rest=arg[j+1:]
                    if rest:
                        if rest.startswith('='):
                            rest=rest[1:]
                        if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None or opts['file_search_regex'] is not None:
                            if not opts['silent']:
                                eprint("ERR: File search regex (-g or -G) already specified.")
                            print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
                        opts['filename_pattern']=rest
                        break
                    else:
                        if i+1 < len(args):
                            i+=1
                            if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None or opts['file_search_regex'] is not None:
                                if not opts['silent']:
                                    eprint("ERR: File search regex (-g or -G) already specified.")
                                print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
                            opts['filename_pattern']=args[i]
                        break
                elif ch=='G':
                    rest=arg[j+1:]
                    if rest:
                        if rest.startswith('='):
                            rest=rest[1:]
                        if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None or opts['file_search_regex'] is not None:
                            if not opts['silent']:
                                eprint("ERR: File search regex (-g or -G) already specified.")
                            print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
                        opts['file_search_regex']=rest
                        break
                    else:
                        if i+1 < len(args):
                            i+=1
                            if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None or opts['file_search_regex'] is not None:
                                if not opts['silent']:
                                    eprint("ERR: File search regex (-g or -G) already specified.")
                                print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
                            opts['file_search_regex']=args[i]
                        break
                elif ch=='p':
                    rest=arg[j+1:]
                    if rest:
                        if rest.startswith('='):
                            rest=rest[1:]
                        opts['path_to_ignore']=rest
                        break
                    else:
                        if i+1 < len(args):
                            i+=1
                            opts['path_to_ignore']=args[i]
                        break
                elif ch=='H':
                    opts['heading']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='0':
                    opts['null']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='c':
                    opts['count']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='l':
                    opts['files_with_matches']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='L':
                    opts['files_without_matches']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='o':
                    opts['only_matching']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='a':
                    opts['all_types']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='D':
                    opts['debug']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='f':
                    opts['follow']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='F' or ch=='Q':
                    opts['literal']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='i':
                    opts['ignore_case']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='s':
                    opts['case_sensitive']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='S':
                    opts['smart_case']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='t':
                    opts['all_text']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='u':
                    opts['unrestricted']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='U':
                    opts['skip_vcs_ignores']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='v':
                    opts['invert_match']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='w':
                    opts['word_regexp']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='z':
                    opts['search_zip']=True; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='n':
                    opts['norecurse']=True; opts['recurse']=False; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='r':
                    opts['recurse']=True; opts['norecurse']=False; j+=1; continue
                elif ch=='V':
                    print("ag version 2.2.0\n\nFeatures:\n  +jit +lzma +zlib"); sys.exit(0)
                elif ch=='h':
                    print_help(); sys.exit(0)
                else:
                    if not opts['silent']:
                        eprint(f"{argv[0]}: invalid option -- '{ch}'")
                    print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
            i+=1; continue
        positional.append(arg); i+=1

    if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None and opts['file_search_regex'] is not None:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint("ERR: File search regex (-g or -G) already specified.")
        print_help(sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)

    pattern=None; paths=[]
    if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None:
        paths=positional if positional else ['.']
    else:
        if positional:
            pattern=positional[0]
            paths=positional[1:] if len(positional)>1 else []
        else:
            pattern=None; paths=[]
    if pattern is not None and not paths:
        paths=['.']
    return opts, pattern, paths

def load_ignore_patterns_from_file(filepath):
    pats=[]
    try:
        with open(filepath,'r',errors='ignore') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip()
                if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                    continue
                if line.startswith('!'):
                    continue
                pats.append(line)
    except:
        pass
    return pats

def should_ignore_file(filepath, opts, search_root):
    if not opts['hidden'] and not opts['unrestricted']:
        rel=os.path.relpath(filepath, search_root) if search_root and os.path.isdir(search_root) else os.path.basename(filepath)
        parts=rel.split(os.sep)
        for part in parts:
            if part.startswith('.') and part not in ('.','..'):
                return True
    basename=os.path.basename(filepath)
    rel=os.path.relpath(filepath, search_root) if search_root and os.path.isdir(search_root) else filepath
    parts=rel.split(os.sep)
    for pat in opts['ignore']:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(basename, pat) or basename==pat:
            return True
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(filepath, pat):
            return True
        for part in parts:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(part, pat) or part==pat:
                return True
    if opts['unrestricted'] or opts['all_types'] or opts['all_text']:
        return False
    try:
        search_root_abs=os.path.abspath(search_root) if search_root else None
    except:
        search_root_abs=None
    file_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(filepath))
    dirs_to_check=[]
    cur=file_dir; cnt=0
    while True:
        dirs_to_check.append(cur)
        if search_root_abs and os.path.abspath(cur)==search_root_abs:
            break
        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent==cur:
            break
        cur=parent
        cnt+=1
        if cnt>100:
            break
        if search_root_abs is None:
            break
    patterns=[]
    if opts['path_to_ignore']:
        patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(opts['path_to_ignore']))
    home=os.path.expanduser("~")
    agignore_home=os.path.join(home,".agignore")
    if os.path.isfile(agignore_home):
        patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(agignore_home))
    for d in dirs_to_check:
        ip=os.path.join(d,".ignore")
        if os.path.isfile(ip):
            patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(ip))
        if not opts['skip_vcs_ignores']:
            gp=os.path.join(d,".gitignore")
            if os.path.isfile(gp):
                patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(gp))
            hg=os.path.join(d,".hgignore")
            if os.path.isfile(hg):
                patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(hg))
            ge=os.path.join(d,".git","info","exclude")
            if os.path.isfile(ge):
                patterns.extend(load_ignore_patterns_from_file(ge))
    for pat in patterns:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(basename, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(filepath, pat):
            return True
        if basename==pat:
            return True
        for part in parts:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(part, pat) or part==pat:
                return True
    return False

def is_binary_file(path):
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            chunk=f.read(8192)
            if b'\0' in chunk:
                return True
    except:
        return False
    return False

def compile_pattern(pattern_str, opts):
    flags=0
    pat=pattern_str
    if opts['literal']:
        pat=re.escape(pat)
    if opts['word_regexp']:
        pat=r'\b'+pat+r'\b'
    if opts['case_sensitive']:
        flags=0
    elif opts['ignore_case']:
        flags=re.IGNORECASE
    else:
        if opts['smart_case']:
            if any(c.isupper() for c in pattern_str):
                flags=0
            else:
                flags=re.IGNORECASE
        else:
            flags=0
    if opts['multiline']:
        flags|=re.DOTALL
    try:
        compiled=re.compile(pat, flags)
    except re.error as e:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint(f"ERR: Bad regex! pcre_compile() failed at position {getattr(e,'pos',0)}: {e.msg}")
            eprint("If you meant to search for a literal string, run ag with -Q")
        sys.exit(2)
    return compiled

def file_matches_regex(regex_str, filepath):
    try:
        if re.search(regex_str, filepath):
            return True
        if re.search(regex_str, os.path.basename(filepath)):
            return True
    except re.error:
        pass
    return False

def walk_files(start_path_original, opts):
    start_abs=os.path.abspath(start_path_original)
    if os.path.isfile(start_abs):
        yield (start_abs, start_path_original)
        return
    max_depth=opts['depth']
    if max_depth==-1:
        max_depth=float('inf')
    stack=[(start_abs,0,start_path_original)]
    while stack:
        cur_abs, cur_depth, orig_prefix = stack.pop()
        if cur_depth>max_depth:
            continue
        try:
            entries=os.listdir(cur_abs)
        except Exception as e:
            if not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"ERR: Error opening directory {cur_abs}: {getattr(e,'strerror',str(e))}")
            continue
        for entry in entries:
            full_abs=os.path.join(cur_abs, entry)
            if orig_prefix == '.':
                display = os.path.relpath(full_abs, start_abs)
            else:
                rel = os.path.relpath(full_abs, cur_abs)
                display = os.path.join(orig_prefix, rel)
            if display.startswith("./"):
                display=display[2:]
            try:
                st=os.lstat(full_abs)
            except:
                if not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {full_abs}")
                continue
            is_link=stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)
            is_dir=stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)
            if is_link:
                if opts['follow']:
                    try:
                        rs=os.stat(full_abs)
                        is_dir=stat.S_ISDIR(rs.st_mode)
                    except:
                        if not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {full_abs}")
                        continue
                else:
                    continue
            if is_dir:
                if should_ignore_file(full_abs, opts, start_abs):
                    continue
                if cur_depth < max_depth:
                    if not opts['norecurse']:
                        stack.append((full_abs, cur_depth+1, display))
                continue
            else:
                if should_ignore_file(full_abs, opts, start_abs):
                    continue
                yield (full_abs, display)

def search_file(abs_path, display_path, compiled, opts):
    matches=[]
    total_count=0
    bytes_searched=0
    try:
        if is_binary_file(abs_path):
            if opts['all_text'] and not opts['search_binary']:
                return [],0,0,False
            if not (opts['all_types'] or opts['unrestricted'] or opts['search_binary']):
                return [],0,0,False
            try:
                with open(abs_path,'rb') as bf:
                    data=bf.read()
                    bytes_searched=len(data)
                    txt=data.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                    if compiled and compiled.search(txt):
                        return [],1,bytes_searched,True
                    else:
                        return [],0,bytes_searched,False
            except:
                return [],0,0,False

        lines=None
        if opts['search_zip']:
            if abs_path.endswith('.gz'):
                try:
                    with gzip.open(abs_path,'rt',errors='ignore') as f:
                        lines=f.readlines()
                except:
                    lines=None
            elif abs_path.endswith('.xz') or abs_path.endswith('.lzma'):
                try:
                    with lzma.open(abs_path,'rt',errors='ignore') as f:
                        lines=f.readlines()
                except:
                    lines=None
        if lines is None:
            with open(abs_path,'r',errors='ignore') as f:
                lines=f.readlines()
        bytes_searched=sum(len(l.encode('utf-8',errors='ignore')) for l in lines)

        use_multiline = opts['multiline'] and compiled and '\n' in compiled.pattern

        if use_multiline:
            full_text=''.join(lines)
            if opts['invert_match']:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    if not compiled.search(line):
                        matches.append((idx,line,None))
                        total_count+=1
                        if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                            break
            else:
                for m in compiled.finditer(full_text):
                    total_count+=1
                    start = full_text[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
                    end = full_text[:m.end()].count('\n')+1
                    for ln in range(start, end+1):
                        if ln-1 < len(lines):
                            lc=lines[ln-1]
                        else:
                            lc=''
                        matches.append((ln, lc, m))
                    if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                        break
                if not (opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']):
                    seen=set()
                    dedup=[]
                    for ln,lc,mobj in matches:
                        if ln not in seen:
                            seen.add(ln)
                            dedup.append((ln,lc,mobj))
                    matches=dedup
        else:
            for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                if opts['invert_match']:
                    if not compiled.search(line):
                        matches.append((idx,line,None))
                        total_count+=1
                        if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                            break
                else:
                    ms=list(compiled.finditer(line))
                    if ms:
                        total_count+=len(ms)
                        if opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']:
                            for m in ms:
                                matches.append((idx,line,m))
                        else:
                            matches.append((idx,line,ms[0]))
                        if opts['max_count'] and total_count>=opts['max_count']:
                            break
    except Exception as e:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint(f"ERR: Error opening file {abs_path}: {e}")
        return [],0,0,False
    return matches, total_count, bytes_searched, False

def main():
    start_time=time.time()
    opts, pattern, paths = parse_args(sys.argv)

    if pattern is None and opts['filename_pattern'] is None:
        if not opts['silent']:
            eprint("ERR: What do you want to search for?")
        sys.exit(1)

    if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
        home=os.path.expanduser("~")
        eprint(f"DEBUG: Found user's home dir: {home}")
        agignore_home=os.path.join(home,".agignore")
        if not os.path.isfile(agignore_home):
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping ignore file {agignore_home}: not readable")
        git_global=os.path.join(home,".config","git","ignore")
        if not os.path.isfile(git_global):
            eprint(f"DEBUG: global core.excludesfile: {git_global}")
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping ignore file {git_global}: not readable")
        q = pattern if pattern else opts['filename_pattern']
        if q:
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Query is {q}")
        eprint("DEBUG: PCRE Version: 8.39 2016-06-14")
        workers = opts['workers'] if opts['workers'] else 7
        eprint(f"DEBUG: Using {workers} workers")
        for i in range(workers):
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Thread {i} set to CPU {i}")
            eprint(f"DEBUG: Worker {i} started")
        for p in paths:
            eprint(f"DEBUG: searching path {p} for {q}")

    # -g mode
    if opts['filename_pattern'] is not None:
        try:
            flags=0
            if opts['ignore_case']:
                flags|=re.IGNORECASE
            elif opts['case_sensitive']:
                flags=0
            else:
                if opts['smart_case']:
                    if opts['filename_pattern'] and any(c.isupper() for c in opts['filename_pattern']):
                        flags=0
                    else:
                        flags|=re.IGNORECASE
            if opts['multiline']:
                flags|=re.DOTALL
            pat=opts['filename_pattern']
            if opts['literal']:
                pat=re.escape(pat)
            if opts['word_regexp']:
                pat=r'\b'+pat+r'\b'
            file_pat_re=re.compile(pat, flags)
        except re.error as e:
            if not opts['silent']:
                eprint(f"ERR: Bad regex! pcre_compile() failed at position {getattr(e,'pos',0)}: {e.msg}")
                eprint("If you meant to search for a literal string, run ag with -Q")
            sys.exit(2)
        files_found=[]
        files_searched=0
        for p in paths:
            if not os.path.exists(p):
                if not opts['silent']:
                    eprint(f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {p}")
                    eprint(f"ERR: Error opening directory {p}: No such file or directory")
                continue
            if os.path.isfile(p):
                files_searched+=1
                if opts['file_types']:
                    matched=False
                    for ft in opts['file_types']:
                        for ext in FILE_TYPES.get(ft,[]):
                            if p.endswith(ext):
                                matched=True; break
                        if matched: break
                    if not matched:
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {os.path.abspath(p)} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if opts['file_search_regex']:
                    if not file_matches_regex(opts['file_search_regex'], p):
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {os.path.abspath(p)} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if should_ignore_file(os.path.abspath(p), opts, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))):
                    continue
                if file_pat_re.search(p) or file_pat_re.search(os.path.basename(p)):
                    files_found.append(p)
                continue
            for abs_p, disp_p in walk_files(p, opts):
                files_searched+=1
                if opts['file_types']:
                    matched=False
                    for ft in opts['file_types']:
                        for ext in FILE_TYPES.get(ft,[]):
                            if abs_p.endswith(ext):
                                matched=True; break
                        if matched: break
                    if not matched:
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if opts['file_search_regex']:
                    if not file_matches_regex(opts['file_search_regex'], abs_p):
                        if opts['debug'] and not opts['silent']:
                            eprint(f"DEBUG: Skipping {abs_p} due to file_search_regex.")
                        continue
                if file_pat_re.search(disp_p) or file_pat_re.search(os.path.basename(disp_p)) or file_pat_re.search(abs_p):
                    files_found.append(disp_p)
        for f in files_found:
            if opts['null']:
                sys.stdout.write(f+'\0')
            else:
                print(f)
        if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{0} matches")
            print(f"{0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{files_searched} files searched")
            print(f"{0} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
        sys.exit(0)

    is_empty_query = (pattern == "")
    if not is_empty_query:
        compiled=compile_pattern(pattern, opts)
    else:
        compiled=None

    def stdout_is_tty():
        try:
            return os.isatty(1)
        except:
            return False
    def is_stdin_pipe():
        try:
            import stat as stmod
            mode=os.fstat(0).st_mode
            return stmod.S_ISFIFO(mode) or stmod.S_ISREG(mode)
        except:
            return False

    is_tty = stdout_is_tty()
    stdin_pipe = is_stdin_pipe()
    if opts['parallel']:
        stdin_pipe=False

    search_stdin=False
    if stdin_pipe and paths==['.']:
        search_stdin=True

    if search_stdin:
        stdin_data=sys.stdin.read()
        files_searched=1
        bytes_searched=len(stdin_data.encode('utf-8',errors='ignore'))
        total_matches=0
        matches_found=[]
        lines=stdin_data.splitlines(keepends=True)
        if not lines and stdin_data:
            lines=[stdin_data]
        if not is_empty_query:
            if opts['invert_match']:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    if not compiled.search(line):
                        matches_found.append((idx,line,None))
                        total_matches+=1
            else:
                for idx,line in enumerate(lines,start=1):
                    ms=list(compiled.finditer(line))
                    if ms:
                        total_matches+=len(ms)
                        if opts['vimgrep'] or opts['only_matching']:
                            for m in ms:
                                matches_found.append((idx,line,m))
                        else:
                            matches_found.append((idx,line,ms[0]))
        if opts['count']:
            if total_matches>0:
                print(total_matches)
            if opts['stats'] or opts['stats_only']:
                elapsed=time.time()-start_time
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
                print(f"{1} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)
        if opts['stats_only']:
            elapsed=time.time()-start_time
            print(f"{total_matches} matches")
            print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
            print(f"{1} files searched")
            print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
            print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0)
        if opts['passthrough']:
            for line in lines:
                print(line.rstrip('\r\n'))
            if opts['stats']:
                elapsed=time.time()-start_time
                print(f"{total_matches} matches")
                print(f"{1 if total_matches>0 else 0} files contained matches")
                print(f"{1} files searched")
                print(f"{bytes_searched} bytes searched")
                print(f"{elapsed:.6f} seconds")
            sys.exit(0 if total_matches>0 else 1)

        numbers_enabled = opts['numbers'] if opts['numbers'] is not None else False
        before=opts['before']; after=opts['after']
        if opts['context']:
            before=opts['context']; after=opts['context']

        if before or after:
            match_lines=set([ln for ln,_,_ in matches_found])
